history.prompt: Clean isometric cutaway illustration of a tiered mechanical sorting tower, technical drawing style, axonometric projection. A wide top funnel mechanism filtering down into four distinct, organized modular storage trays and connector bays. Flat muted color palette with a single bright amber accent color highlighting the organized lower layers. Thin consistent line weight, recognizable hardware modules with visible depth, generous empty margin, minimal editorial aesthetic.

Matte clay 3D render of a small mechanical assembly on a neutral seamless backdrop. Three recognizable engineered parts in a clear physical arrangement: a wide upper housing routing down into a stack of precisely latched memory bays and a modular connector block. Matte surfaces with molding seams and contact shadows, single soft key light, muted slate and warm grey editorial palette. Generous negative space, minimalist composition.

Matte clay 3D render of a modular mechanical assembly, studio render on a neutral seamless backdrop. A central processor housing connected to three distinct, tiered storage bays with latched covers and visible connector ribbons. Soft even key light, matte surfaces with subtle moulding seams and soft contact shadows. Muted modern editorial palette of slate blue and pale grey, generous negative space, asymmetric composition.

style_when: the news is structural and abstract — a stack reordered, a layer added, a flow rerouted — and there is no literal object that carries it, so the idea is stated as a small physical assembly of recognisable parts rather than as bare shapes
prompt: Matte clay 3D render of a small multi-tiered mechanical memory assembly resting on a weathered concrete surface. The structure features three distinct vertical layers: a wide shallow top working tray, a middle routing bay with visible connector ridges, and a heavy foundational storage block with closed latches. Asymmetric three-quarter angle composition positioned off-centre to the right, leaving generous negative editorial space on the left. The recognizable engineered parts are rendered in matte muted polymer and dark brushed steel tones with visible moulding seams. A single directional key light rakes across the assembly from the top left, throwing a deep, long cast shadow across the concrete.
negative_prompt: text, typography, letters, numbers, wordmarks, watermarks, logos, labels, UI
rationale: A matte clay 3D render is ideal for abstract structural concepts, allowing us to visualize software memory tiers as a tangible, layered mechanical assembly.
subject: A multi-tiered mechanical memory assembly with distinct modular bays
alt_text: A tiered mechanical assembly with multiple distinct modular bays resting on a concrete surface.
caption: Effective AI agents require structured, multi-tiered memory systems rather than relying on a single sprawling context window.
title: Tiered AI Memory Structure
